title: Rerun the GPT-6.2 Astra audit after its P1 findings merge
body:
Operator 2026-11-17: implement the GPT-6.2 Astra audit, then rerun it. Ready when the P1 Astra tasks (t-bf8d3x9, t-dgkkmp1, t-vyjf950, t-ysg43y7, t-76cjaca) are merged.
Files: .krn/runs/research/gpt-6-2/RUN.md
Outcome: the astra command in RUN.md is rerun on the new HEAD; its report is saved under .krn/runs/research/gpt-6-2/, each earlier finding is marked fixed / still open with evidence, and new findings get tasks.
Proof: .krn/runs/research/gpt-6-2/astra-rerun-verdicts.md exists and every line names a task id or a fixed SHA.
